text.content:
The borough over the crater: the money, and the people who serve it.

Region: Night City, center. Districts: Corporate Plaza (A) and Downtown (B)
Controlled by: The megacorps' towers, the NCPD's best-funded patrols, and Precinct 1
The feel of it: The shiniest place in the Free City, built on a grave
Notable locations: Memorial Park, the Arasaka Tower Site, The View, Reconciliation Park; the Bridgehead, the Clock Tower, Night Corp HQ, N54 HQ, 7th Hell, Camden Court
Danger: Corporate in the Plaza; Moderate / Corporate in Downtown

The 2023 bomb turned the old Corporate Center into a radioactive crater, the Hot Zone, which the NCPD only watched through AV gunsights for decades. In 2052 the crater was cleared and rebuilt as Corporate Plaza: two ring roads around Memorial Park, eight avenues running out like spokes, and a megacorp tower on every lot. Downtown, which swallowed Little Europe after the Purge, makes the Plaza's coffee.

By day 400,000 office workers fill the Plaza; at night it's tower guards, cleaning crews and drones. Downtown changes shift at seven, when the Plaza crowd pours down Republic Way to the trains and Little Europe's club strip lights up block by block.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.17; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.07
